measurements.name: Bumper-to-bumper length
measurements.notes: Repeated readings along driver-side wheels; tape not perfectly flat; observed range, not uncertainty interval.

measurements.name: Roof centerline length
measurements.notes: Center top back to center top front; distinct datum from bumpers.

measurements.name: Typical window pillar pitch
measurements.notes: Front-to-first and last-to-rear intervals shorter; 14 pillars, 15 total reference positions including front; rear endpoint membership unclear.

nominal_longitudinal_model.datum: x=0 at front bumper, positive rearward; visualization convention
nominal_longitudinal_model.notes: Preserves independently read front overhang and wheelbase, fits midpoint of overall length; absorbs 3 in residual into approximate rear overhang. Not a corrected field reading.

interior_cross_section.notes: Assumes springline width equals floor width and symmetric circular arc. Neither assumption verified; not exterior geometry.

pillar_layout.notes: No absolute pillar phase or full bow map established. Count/datum ambiguity: 14 interior pillars imply 13 typical intervals (377 in) plus two end intervals; if 15 total positions instead include both endpoints, 12 typical intervals (348 in) plus two short intervals. Do not fit to aisle or roof length without common datums. Retain existing nominal phase provisionally if needed; show end spacing as assumption.
